plans.phaseTitle: Phase 1 — Measure, then make the Studio editor safe and fast (no visible redesign)
plans.goal: Phase 1 makes /studio/editor safe and fast. Safe means students never lose work, no shortcut or generator destroys hidden or unrelated work, and the save state is honest. Fast means smooth playback, editing and loading on school Chromebooks (1366x655 focus-mode window) and laptops (1440x900). There is no visible redesign. Every change is proven against a baseline that is recorded before any code changes. The work is 18 shippable milestones, about 30–35 developer-weeks, each merged as a merge-commit PR after local verification (main deploys to prod; there is no CI). New UI in this phase is kept to the minimum: the save chip, Projects dialog, Opening overlay, Loading-sounds pill, musical-typing chip, Premium badge and a few inline banners. It sits in the current layout and already follows decisions 2–3 (12 px labels, 28 px controls, 24x24 targets, white-pill primary, white/10 selected, no teal) so Phase 2 can restyle it. Internal view ids, dock tab ids and data-tutorial-id anchors stay unchanged, and all 8 lessons keep passing.
exitCriteria: Common gate: for every milestone, npm run lint (prettier + eslint --max-warnings 0, so no TODO comments; tsc -b), npx vitest run and npm run studio:check pass locally before its merge-commit PR.

Persistence: the Playwright round trips keep 100% of project-document registry fields. They cover refresh during playback, SPA return, abrupt tab close, and cloud save→open against the mock API in both legacy-fallback and document-field modes. Boots with new, template, demo, lesson, song, practice, jam and collab intents leak 0 fields from the previous project.

No silent loss: any entry that replaces unsaved work (template, demo, lesson, new project, collab link, Song page, File ▸ Open) keeps the work as an IndexedDB draft, shows a toast and lists the draft in the Projects dialog. Reopening the draft gives an identical fingerprint. The save chip shows Saved / Saving… / Unsaved / Saved on this device / Couldn't save – Retry correctly. An invalid boot link (e.g. ?tutorial=bogus) changes nothing.

Playback performance (chromebook profile, 4x CPU throttle, demo-midnight-groove): steady playback makes 0 main-store writes/s. DawAppInner, TransportBar, Timeline, track headers and dock make 0 React commits/s outside user input. Lead Sheet and Practice commit only at chord or bar boundaries. At most 1 long task (>50 ms) per 20 s, and p95 frame time is ≤20 ms. With the editor stopped and idle, no rAF loops run.

Editing performance: a fader or knob drag makes 1 store write, 1 undo entry and 1 Yjs update per gesture. Timeline draw() p95 is ≤4 ms while scrolling 6 × 3-min audio clips. One note edit in a 6-part, 32-bar Score paints in ≤50 ms on the laptop profile.

Timing: golden offline renders pass at 44.1 and 48 kHz. Schedule traces put mid-clip starts, loop laps, metronome after pause/resume and the count-in downbeat within ±2 ms of the grid. Seeking while playing leaves no stale audio or hanging notes. Note edits made during playback are heard on the next pass. Export never leaves Tone on the offline context and can be cancelled.

Load: the boot DAW chunk is ≤150 KB gzip (from ~286 KB). The editor shell paints without waiting for songs content. The first Play on a demo waits behind a 'Loading sounds' pill and is never silent. A failed instrument load shows Retry, and Retry recovers.

Safety: no shortcut acts on a view the student cannot see. Text fields and browser zoom are never hijacked. Prism Create, builder Clear, suggestion commit and lead-sheet paste never delete clips or chord symbols outside their written range. Leaving a collab session never deletes a project that existed before the session. Split, overwrite and undo never produce silent audio clips.

Lessons: all 8 lessons pass the Playwright walkthrough as a premium user, with every data-tutorial-id present. The 4 Prism lessons show a Premium badge, and free students get the upgrade prompt without Prism being unlocked. Refreshing mid-lesson resumes at the same step with the work intact.

Hygiene: knip is clean for src/daw. The music-atlas-api document contract is merged in docs/ and acknowledged by the API owner. docs/studio-perf/phase-1-exit.md compares baseline and final numbers for every metric above.

milestones.title: Baseline, test harness and audit archive (no product behaviour change)
milestones.why: There is no CI and main deploys to prod, so every later milestone has to prove its effect with local, repeatable measurements. Today's numbers and losses must be captured before any code changes, and the audit has to move out of /private/tmp before those files disappear.
risks: Headless Chrome audio clocks differ from real devices, so traces and render features are relative baselines, not absolute truths.
The React probe adds overhead. Keep the per-component detail mode optional and compare like with like.
Never bind the owner's dev server port 5179 (scripts/graphSmoke.mjs refuses it); use 5263 or --reuse an already-running bypass server.
The mock Studio API can drift from music-atlas-api. Type it against src/lib/studio-projects/api.ts and update it in 1.5.

steps.title: Archive the audit in docs/
steps.details: scripts/studio-audit/exportAudit.mjs <w902nuv9m.output> <journal.jsonl> writes docs/studio-audit-2026-10/ with these files: (1) README.md: stats, how to read, owner decisions 1–11 overriding the synthesis (no Simple/Advanced mode or density toggle; neutral accent; focus mode; Premium badges instead of unlocking Prism). (2) register.md: all 622 lines by severity. (3) findings.json: all 622 full findings taken from the journal's type:'result' lines. (4) synthesis.md: themes, quick wins, principles, risks, layout sketch. (5) unit-proposals.md. (6) components.md. (7) research.md and research.json. (8) phase-map.json: finding id → 1.x / Phase 2 / Phase 3 / deferred, seeded from this plan. Add docs/studio-audit-2026-10/*.json to .prettierignore next to the existing 'Generated caches and audit dumps' entries, and prettier-format the .md files.
reuse: /* eslint-env node */ header convention from scripts/graphSmoke.mjs

steps.title: Shared Playwright harness and in-app dev probes
steps.details: (1) Extract startServer/isListening/waitClosed from scripts/graphSmoke.mjs into scripts/lib/devServer.mjs (graphSmoke imports it). (2) scripts/studio-perf/harness.mjs spawns node_modules/.bin/vite --port 5263 --strictPort with VITE_DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=1 (or --reuse=http://localhost:5179 for an already-running bypass server). It launches playwright-core chromium with --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required and fake media flags. Profiles: chromebook (1366x655, DSF 1, CDP Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate 4; Network.emulateNetworkConditions about 10 Mbps / 40 ms for load runs) and laptop (1440x900, DSF 2). (3) scripts/studio-perf/probes.mjs uses addInitScript for: longtask and long-animation-frame observers; a rAF frame log; a minimal __REACT_DEVTOOLS_GLOBAL_HOOK__ that counts commits; a store probe that subscribes to window.__MA_STORE__ and counts writes/s and changed top-level keys. (4) In DawApp's existing DEV_AUTH_BYPASS block: expose __MA_AUDIO_ENGINE__; add a DevProfiler (React <Profiler> only under the bypass) around TransportBar, TimelineWithHeaders, LibraryPanel, ChannelStrip and each view, writing to window.__MA_RENDER_STATS__; add cheap performance.mark('ma:daw:*') marks (module eval, first render, boot done, engine ready, first audible).

steps.title: Perf and load scenarios
steps.details: scripts/studio-perf/perf.mjs scenarios: (1) idle: 10 s stopped on ?demo=demo-midnight-groove. (2) playback: 20 s of Space-play, recording commits per region, store writes/s and keys, long tasks, LoAF, p50/p95 frame time. (3) views: Score, Lead Sheet, Mix (studio) and Practice (?practiceMode=dorian&practiceRoot=d). (4) fader-drag: 2 s on a TrackHeader volume. (5) note-drag: dock piano roll. (6) collab-presence: optional --collab, starts npm run partykit:dev with two contexts. (7) load: cold ?demo=demo-sunset-keys and ?template=project-pop; record navigation→DawApp chunk request start, →[data-tutorial-id='track-headers'] visible, Play click→first non-zero master analyser reading, and bytes by host (self vs github.io) before the first audible output. Writes JSON plus summary.md.

steps.title: Bundle report
steps.details: vite.config.ts: honour ANALYZE_OUT (the default keeps docs/optimization/baseline-2026-06-10/bundle.html) and add a second visualizer instance with template 'raw-data'. scripts/studio-perf/bundle.mjs runs the analyze build and writes bundle.json: DawApp chunk raw/gzip/brotli, entry chunk, JS fetched for /studio/editor, and the top 25 DAW modules. The baseline is about 1.13 MB / 286 KB gzip.

steps.title: Reload round-trip suite with a mock Studio API
steps.details: scripts/studio-perf/roundtrip.mjs, fixtures/kitchenSink.mjs and fingerprint.mjs. The kitchen-sink fixture builds, through __MA_STORE__ and __MA_SYNTH_STORE__, every field in the audit's persistence matrix: trackRole, audioInputChannel, durationTicks, ccEvents, sends, automation, chord lane, mode dorian, 6/8, markers, mastering chain + bypass + masterVolume, returns, every score and lead-sheet mark, and synth edits. Scenarios: R1 edit while playing then refresh; R2 SPA return (editor → /studio → history.back()); R3 cloud save → ?project= open via mockStudioApi.mjs (page.route on VITE_MUSIC_ATLAS_API_URL /api/studio/projects* and assets; an in-memory server with 'legacy' mode = today's contract and 'document' mode = the 1.5 contract); R4 leak check (non-defaults, then ?new=1 / ?template= / ?demo= / ?tutorial=, expecting defaults); R5 ?tutorial=bogus must keep the work (decision 11). Results ratchet against knownLosses.json: a new loss fails the run and a fixed loss is reported.

steps.title: Golden offline renders and live schedule traces
steps.details: scripts/studio-perf/golden.mjs loads fixtures from scripts/studio-perf/fixtures/sessions/*.json (SessionData v2): demo, loop range, trimmed audio clips with offsetSeconds and gain built from a generated sine, an Oracle two-note sequence, and metronome + count-in. In the page it imports '/src/daw/persistence/SessionSerializer.ts' and '/src/daw/audio/renderProject.ts'; on the Vite dev server these are the same module instances the app uses. It renders at 44100 and 48000 and stores features (20 ms RMS per channel, onsets, peak, spectral centroid) in docs/studio-perf/goldens/. Trace mode patches AudioScheduledSourceNode.prototype.start/stop and Tone transport 'start'/'loop' events during a 12 s live loop with a mid-clip start, pause/resume and count-in, and reports clip, metronome and downbeat error vs the grid in ms. Today's failures (48 kHz IR error, clips about 100 ms early) are recorded as the baseline.

steps.title: Lesson walkthrough and anchor inventory
steps.details: scripts/studio-perf/lessons.mjs runs all 8 TUTORIALS through ?tutorial=<id>. For each step it waits for the coach card, asserts that the first present id in target[] is visible, and performs the step with scripts/studio-perf/lessonDrivers.mjs (store actions via __MA_STORE__/__MA_SYNTH_STORE__, or a click on the anchor; e.g. the WOBBLE preset through the synth store). It then asserts tutorialStepIndex advanced, using Next for free-form steps. src/daw/components/Tutorial/__tests__/tutorialAnchors.test.ts statically checks that every target exists as a data-tutorial-id literal or a known template (chanstrip-tab-*, view-switch-*, fx-slot-*, fx-add-*, mixer-sends-*, return-*, sampler-mode-*, add-track-*).

steps.title: Ratchet unit tests for today's losses
steps.details: src/daw/persistence/__tests__/persistenceMatrix.test.ts adds one it.fails case per field that the local or cloud codec loses today, so the suite passes now and flips when a fix lands. src/daw/hooks/__tests__/autosaveStarvation.test.ts does the same for autosave starvation: fake timers plus 30 Hz setPosition, marked it.fails.

steps.title: npm scripts and committed baseline
steps.details: Add package.json scripts: studio:baseline, studio:check, studio:perf, studio:roundtrip, studio:golden, studio:lessons and studio:bundle. Run them on both profiles and commit docs/studio-perf/baselines/2026-10-xx/summary.md; its headline numbers become the targets. Add the baseline JSON to .prettierignore.

verification: npm run lint; npx vitest run (the new it.fails tests pass).
npm run studio:baseline completes on the chromebook and laptop profiles and writes summary.md.
bundle.json reports the DawApp chunk at about 286 KB gzip.
The R1–R5 loss list matches the audit matrix (time signature, markers, mastering, score marks, trackRole, chord lane on cloud…).
The golden run records the 48 kHz export failure.
studio:lessons passes 8/8, or any failure is written to knownLosses as pre-existing.
npm run smoke:graph -- --only=mock still passes after the devServer extraction.

milestones.title: Quick wins I — stop losing work
milestones.why: The most damaging defects have small, one-file fixes, and they should ship before any refactor: edits lost during playback, stale restores, wipes on bad links, hidden clip deletes, records over takes and deleted cloud projects.
risks: A synchronous flush on pagehide serializes the whole project. Measure it on a 10-track project and keep it under 50 ms.
Closing tokenless sockets on PartyKit may drop guests who connect without a token today. Check before running npm run partykit:deploy, and deploy the server after the client.
The silent backup slot can't be reached in the UI until 1.4.

steps.title: Autosave that playback can't starve
steps.details: Rewrite useAutosave so it is driven by persisted fields only. useStore.subscribe(selectPersisted, schedule, {equalityFn: shallow}) watches the refs serializeSession reads (tracks, chordRegions, bpm, prism keys, returns, masterAutomation, project id/name/composer, loop/metronome). It also subscribes useSynthStore patch keys. Debounce 1.5 s with a 5 s maxWait, and flush with writeLocalSession() synchronously on pagehide, visibilitychange→hidden and effect cleanup.

steps.title: Never restore over a live session
steps.details: Add a module marker sessionLoadedAt in localSession.ts, set by deserializeSession, deserializeCloudProject, resetSessionToEmpty and every seed. DawApp's default boot branch skips restoreLocalSessionIfPresent() when the marker is set, so an SPA return keeps the in-memory session; a cold load still restores.

steps.title: Validate every boot intent before clearing anything (decision 11)
steps.details: In the DawApp boot effect, each branch validates before it clears: getTutorial, getProjectTemplate, getDemoProject, getSong after ensureSongContent, practice params, and the project fetch. An invalid intent shows the error and keeps the session. Today the tutorial branch clears before it validates. Before clearing for a valid intent, copy the outgoing autosave to 'musicAtlas:daw:autosave:previous', a silent one-slot backup that 1.4 imports as a draft.

steps.title: End stale lesson/practice context and cross-project leaks
steps.details: resetSessionToEmpty, deserializeSession and deserializeCloudProject do the following: clear practiceSession (currentView→'arrange' unless this is a practice boot); call quitTutorial() unless this is a lesson boot; reset rootLocked, rootTrackColor, clearDetectedKey(), markers, the time signature (4/4), mastering-slice defaults, returns (defaultReturns()), every score/lead-sheet mark and the prismSuggestion modal state. Call resetUndoHistory() at the end of the template, demo, practice, jam and collab-new seeds.

steps.title: Stable chord ids, track roles and input routing
steps.details: nextChordId() returns crypto.randomUUID(), and duplicate ids are removed in deserializeSession, deserializeCloudProject and pullDocIntoStore. Serialize trackRole and default a missing value to 'auto'; trackRole() treats undefined as auto. Serialize audioInputChannel locally only (never to the cloud) and keep it in the yjsToZustand applyTracksFromDoc/pullDocIntoStore prev-merge. The views default null to {mode:'mono',channel:0} instead of disconnecting. The engine-facing effects in VocalView and GuitarBassView depend on getEngineReadyVersion()/subscribeEngineReady.

steps.title: Interim keyboard guard
steps.details: useKeyboardShortcuts returns early on e.defaultPrevented, e.altKey, an editable target (input/textarea/select/[contenteditable]) except Mod+S, and targets inside [role=dialog]/[role=menu]. Clip commands run only when currentView==='arrange' and no clip is being edited. uiSlice.setCurrentView clears selectedClipId/TrackId. PrismSuggestionModal handles keydown in the capture phase with stopPropagation, following the PopOutOverlay pattern.

steps.title: One requestRecord() command
steps.details: src/daw/commands/requestRecord.ts holds the overwrite check (an audio track with a take under the record range). A RecordGuard ConfirmModal is mounted once at the DawApp root, so it also works in Practice view. The TransportBar record button and the R key both call requestRecord().

steps.title: Clip-relative origins in docked note editors
steps.details: ChannelStrip and KeyboardView pass clipStartTick=0 and timelineStartTick=clip.startTick to PianoRoll. PianoRollModal never mixes clip.startTick into the origin. DrumMachineView draws events clip-relative.

steps.title: Collab: never delete pre-existing work; tear down dead rooms
steps.details: collabSlice records projectIdAtJoin and sessionDraftProjectId (set by ensureProjectId when the session minted the draft). LeaveSavePrompt's leave-without-saving path deletes only sessionDraftProjectId and is relabelled 'Discard this session's changes'. CollabProvider re-attaches handleServerMessage on every provider 'status' event that reports 'connecting', replacing the attachWs retry. On room:not-found, full, kicked or closing it calls teardown() before showing the prompt. In party.ts, onConnect closes connections without valid auth (code 4401) before any Yjs sync; deploy with npm run partykit:deploy after the client.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check (roundtrip, lessons).
vitest: useAutosave writes during simulated 30 Hz setPosition within 5 s and flushes on a dispatched pagehide. The autosaveStarvation it.fails case now passes and is flipped to it.
vitest: invalid tutorial, demo and template intents leave the localStorage autosave untouched.
vitest: a reset-leak test sets non-default markers, metre, mastering, key lock and score marks, runs resetSessionToEmpty and gets defaults.
vitest: a duplicate-chord-id fixture deserializes to unique ids. trackRole and audioInputChannel round-trip and survive a collab prev-merge (Y.Doc unit).
vitest: the keyboard guard (jsdom) makes no store change for Delete in the score view, Cmd+Z in an input or Alt+R.
vitest: LeaveSavePrompt calls studioProjectsApi.remove only for the session draft.
Party test (classroom_session/party.test.ts pattern): an unauthenticated socket closes with 4401.

studio:roundtrip: R1 (edits made while playing survive refresh), R2 (SPA return is not overwritten) and R5 (a bogus lesson keeps work) pass. The ratchet marks trackRole and audioInputChannel as fixed.
studio:lessons 8/8.

milestones.title: Quick wins II — lag, timing, honesty and Premium lessons (decision 8)
milestones.why: These are cheap fixes for the biggest lag sources and for wrong audio or labels. Decision 8 ships here because the new /studio/production tab sends free students into a Prism lock today.
risks: Per-channel SoundFont routing lowers GM track level and removes the synth-wide GM reverb, which is audible. Record it in golden renders and teacher release notes.
Aliasing tokens on body could restyle app portals while the editor is mounted. Alias only the --color-* tokens and remove the class on unmount.
Decision 8 gating depends on subscription loading. Wait for useIsPremium().isLoading so premium users aren't treated as free.

steps.title: Presence stops the broadcast loop
steps.details: The CollabProvider presence subscription becomes useStore.subscribe(selector, cb, {equalityFn: shallow}). lastActiveAt is refreshed at most every 10 s, on a timer that runs only while in a room.

steps.title: Playhead out of the Timeline and TransportBar top levels
steps.details: Move Timeline's position subscription into a TimelinePlayhead child, copying the Playhead in PianoRoll.tsx. Move the TransportBar position readout into its own memo child. Replace the whole-tracks selectors in TransportBar and PrismStudio with primitive or derived ones (e.g. hasAudioTake, the selected track's instrument).

steps.title: Undo tracking stops leaking and serializing
steps.details: initUndoTracking becomes idempotent (module flag) and returns an unsubscribe that the DawApp effect calls. The identity check runs first, and JSON.stringify runs only inside the 300 ms debounce. Change detection no longer uses structuredClone in readMarks.

steps.title: Delete MeshGradientBg
steps.details: Remove the component, its DawApp mount and its daw.css hooks.

steps.title: Timing one-liners
steps.details: DrumMachineEngine.noteOn uses time ?? Tone.immediate(). The usePlaybackEngine loop-lap path passes clip.offsetSeconds and clip.gain through an options object. MetronomeEngine.start uses scheduleRepeat(cb, interval, 0) and derives the beat from transport.getTicksAtTime(time) and the metre. useAudioEngine initialises isReady from audioEngine.getIsInitialized(). useTransport pauses the transport on unmount.

steps.title: SoundFont per-channel routing
steps.details: SoundFontAdapter init and dispose use sharedSynth.connectChannel/disconnectChannel(nativeOutput, channel) instead of connect(). The synth-wide reverb/chorus on output 0 is disabled. Record the level change as an accepted golden diff.

steps.title: Oracle reloads and exports get reverb and the project tempo
steps.details: applySynthStateToEngine(engine, snap, {projectBpm}) calls setReverbParams and setBPM(projectBpm). Its callers in the usePlaybackEngine init and renderProject pass the store bpm.

steps.title: Export works at any device rate and always restores Tone
steps.details: renderProject renders at opts.sampleRate ?? audioEngine.getSampleRate(). The reverbIR nativeCache and processedCache are keyed by sampleRate. It captures const live = Tone.getContext() and restores it in a finally block.

steps.title: Master honesty
steps.details: The usePlaybackEngine mastering effect pushes an all-disabled TrackEffectState while masteringBypass is on, and renderProject honours it. Bypass becomes an aria-pressed toggle (white/10 when on). Gain Match is hidden. The 'LUFS' meter is relabelled 'Peak' with a dBFS readout.

steps.title: Mode-aware Prism suggestions
steps.details: suggestionEngine.extractGraphSeed/generateSuggestions convert seeds with modeToIonianLabel, voice chords from rootMidi − getModeOffset(mode) and store degreeKey via ionianToModeLabel, as prismSlice already does.

steps.title: Small correctness fixes
steps.details: NoteEditorBar passes the row explicitly: onDuration(choice, id) → applyDuration(choice, dotted, id), and the dot toggle does the same. leadsheet-print.css rules move under body.ma-print-leadsheet, a class added on beforeprint and removed on afterprint by LeadSheetView, LeadSheetScoreView and ScoreView. LFONodeEditor maps the pointer through getBoundingClientRect scale.

steps.title: Portaled dialogs get tokens; white-pill primaries
steps.details: DawApp toggles body.daw-active while it is mounted, and the daw.css token selector becomes '.daw-root, body.daw-active'. TutorialLayer's themeVars copy is deleted. The CoachCard Next button, Prism Create, the non-destructive ConfirmModal confirm and the LeaveSavePrompt primary use the white pill (#fff fill, #101012 text, rounded-full).

steps.title: Premium badge and upgrade prompt for the 4 Prism lessons (decision 8)
steps.details: (1) Split src/daw/components/Tutorial/tutorialCatalog.ts (id, title, subtitle, difficulty, estMinutes, requiresPremium) from the step logic. requiresPremium is true for make-first-track, jazz-color-your-chords, edm-design-the-drop and rnb-mix-and-polish, and a unit test derives it from the steps (requires.channelStripTab==='prism' or prism-* targets). (2) StudioProduction imports only the catalog, so the dashboard stops pulling in step logic and the prism-engine barrel, and shows a neutral 'Premium' chip (white/10, 12 px) on those tiles. (3) For free users (useIsPremium, after isLoading) the tile opens UpgradeLessonDialog (components/ui/dialog): 'This lesson uses Prism, part of Premium', a white-pill 'See plans' → ProfileRoutes.plan, and 'Not now'; it reports trackPaywallViewed. (4) The DawApp boot rejects ?tutorial=<premium id> for free users before clearing anything and shows the same dialog. (5) Prism stays locked in lessons: LockedFeatureOverlay sets inert on locked content, and the Timeline 'Suggest chords' item and openPrismSuggestion are gated. (6) Add VITE_DEV_AUTH_BYPASS_PLAN=free to devBypass (inactive subscription) for tests.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check.

studio:perf playback: Timeline and TransportBar commits are about 0/s (only the playhead child renders). In the collab scenario, DawAppInner commits no longer follow store writes. The idle scenario shows no app rAF loop (LoAF about 0).
vitest: the presence callback fires only on a selection change. initUndoTracking called twice leaves one subscriber set. The metronome beat comes from transport ticks.

vitest: an applySynthStateToEngine spy sees setReverbParams and setBPM(projectBpm). A-aeolian suggestions use minor-key degrees. The catalog flag matches the derived value. A NoteEditorBar cross-row click applies the clicked row (testing-library).

studio:golden: the 48 kHz render succeeds, and the context is restored after a forced failure. The SoundFont level change is accepted with a note. Oracle renders now have reverb tails. Traces show the metronome on grid after pause/resume and loop laps honouring offset and gain.
Playwright: Bypass changes master RMS. The 'Peak' label renders. A portaled ConfirmModal is opaque (computed style).
Playwright (free persona): exactly 4 tiles show Premium, clicking one opens the dialog, and a ?tutorial= deep link neither starts the lesson nor clears work.
Playwright (premium persona): lessons 8/8.

milestones.title: Project document registry and codec v3
milestones.why: Six hand-maintained field lists decide what survives a reload or reset, and they have drifted apart. One registry generates the codec, the resets, the dirty tracking and, later, undo and collab.
risks: deserializeSession's version guard must accept v3 and migrate v1/v2 in the same commit, or every existing autosave fails to restore.
Stable track ids touch the ducker remap, the Oracle patch cache and the collab hydrate together.
A misclassified field silently changes what is saved. The coverage test and roundtrip R1–R4 are the guardrails.
Open question: are the Prism builder progression, strum and tilt project data? The default here is yes.

steps.title: Field registry
steps.details:
src/daw/persistence/projectDocument/fields.ts defines PROJECT_FIELDS (top level) and TRACK_FIELDS, typed {[K in keyof Track]-?: TrackFieldSpec} so tsc fails on any unclassified Track field. Each spec has {default, local, cloud, collab, undo, perUser, resetOnNew, section, migrate}. SESSION_KEYS lists every non-persisted store key with a reason. Classification:
- Document: project meta, bpm, metre, loop range, key/mode/rhythm/genre/swing, the Prism builder (chordSeq, stringSeq, strum, tilt, filter), chordRegions, measure layout (perLine, rowSizes, restMap, fermatas), melodyOverrides, lead-sheet sections/repeats/format/showRepeats/showMelody/melodyTrackId, every score mark, markers, the mastering slice, masterVolume, masterAutomation, returns, pitch edits, chordPromptDismissed.
- Per-user, draft only: arm, monitor, inputs, audioInputChannel, audioMidiSource, metronome, count-in, loopEnabled, zoom/scroll/grid/snap, clipColorMode, view/panels.
- Session: position, selection, clipboard, live recording, analysis caches, the detected-key bus, collab state, modal flags.

steps.title: Coverage tests
steps.details: src/daw/persistence/__tests__/fieldCoverage.test.ts checks that every non-function key of useStore.getState() appears in PROJECT_FIELDS or SESSION_KEYS, and that every Track key appears in TRACK_FIELDS (also enforced at compile time).

steps.title: Codec v3 for the local session
steps.details: src/daw/persistence/projectDocument/codec.ts has encodeSessionV3/decodeSessionV3 generated from the registry, with SESSION_SCHEMA_VERSION=3. migrations.ts migrates v1→v2→v3, and the deserializeSession guard is updated in the same commit. MIDI clips carry durationTicks and ccEvents (columnar via a new encodeCcEvents mirroring encodeMidiEvents), plus pitch edits. Unreadable sessions are quarantined to 'musicAtlas:daw:quarantine:<ts>' with a warning toast, never dropped. serializeSession/deserializeSession become thin wrappers.

steps.title: One initialProjectState() for every reset and load
steps.details: resetSessionToEmpty, deserializeSession, deserializeCloudProject, loadProjectTemplate, demos, song and practice seeds and jam import all start from initialProjectState(), built from the registry defaults with resetOnNew. freshProjectHarmony is deleted.

steps.title: Stable track ids across cloud loads
steps.details: deserializeCloudProject reuses settings.sourceTrackId when it is present and unique, and mints a new id otherwise. The ducker remap becomes an identity map, and the Oracle patch cache is keyed by the stable id.

steps.title: Document version and baseline
steps.details: src/daw/persistence/saveStatusStore.ts is a small zustand store outside the main store. documentVersion is bumped by a subscription over registry refs: top-level refs plus per-track doc-field refs, excluding per-user track fields so that arming a track doesn't mark the project dirty. baselineVersion is set by every load and seed through markDocumentBaseline(). unsavedStudioSession() compares documentVersion > baselineVersion instead of using canUndo().

steps.title: No system writes into the document

milestones.title: Drafts, boot state machine, save chip and Projects dialog (decision 6)
milestones.why: Explicit cloud Save stays, but work must never be lost. Every tab gets crash-safe local drafts. Every entry point auto-keeps unsaved work without a blocking prompt. The save state is always visible.
risks: IndexedDB writes started on pagehide may not finish. The synchronous localStorage mirror covers the last write.
Quota errors on Chromebooks must show in the chip.
Shared school devices: drafts are namespaced by user id and pruned (see the open question on clearing them at sign-out).
Removing the Song page and dashboard prompts changes behaviour and needs a release note.

steps.title: Draft store
steps.details: src/lib/studio-projects/drafts/draftStore.ts uses IndexedDB 'ma-studio-drafts' (store 'drafts', keyPath draftId, index updatedAt). DraftRecord = {draftId, userId, projectId, name, origin: 'session'|'kept'|'migrated', createdAt, updatedAt, documentVersion, savedToCloudVersion, cloudRevision, session: SessionDataV3, context?}. Operations: list, get, put, delete, prune (keep the newest 20 per user or 30 days; drafts equal to the cloud copy are pruned first). Records are namespaced by appUser.id, and the store falls back to localStorage when IDB is missing. On first run it migrates the legacy 'musicAtlas:daw:autosave' and the 1.1 ':previous' backup into drafts.

steps.title: One lock per tab
steps.details: draftLock.ts calls navigator.locks.request('ma-studio-draft:'+draftId, {ifAvailable: true}) and holds the lock for the tab's session. If the lock is taken, the tab forks to a new draftId and toasts 'This project is open in another tab — you're editing a copy'. sessionStorage 'ma:daw:activeDraftId' survives refresh. Without navigator.locks, the tab proceeds unlocked.

steps.title: Version-driven autosave
steps.details: src/daw/persistence/autosave.ts is started once by DawApp and replaces useAutosave. It watches saveStatusStore.documentVersion with a 1 s debounce and 5 s maxWait. Each write goes to IDB asynchronously plus a synchronous localStorage mirror of the last write ('musicAtlas:daw:autosave' reused as {draftId, version, session}). It flushes on pagehide, hidden visibility, unmount and before every session switch. Quota errors set the chip error.

steps.title: openSession(intent) state machine
steps.details:
src/daw/session/openSession.ts plus a pure parseBootIntent(URLSearchParams) and a small useSessionStore {phase: idle|opening|ready|error, label, error}. The machine runs: validate → keepCurrentWorkIfUnsaved() (marks the current draft 'kept' and shows a toast whose 'View' action opens the Projects dialog) → reset with initialProjectState → load or seed → markDocumentBaseline → new draftId + lock → strip only the consumed URL params.
Callers: every DawApp boot branch (project, new, template, demo, tutorial, song, seeded, practiceMode, practiceGenre, jam, collab, rejoin, restore), File ▸ New/Open, the Library tab's 'Replace current project', in-editor collab join, LeaveSavePrompt, and useSongActions (the Song page drops its ConfirmModal for auto-keep).
Restore rules: an SPA return keeps the in-memory draft. A cold load opens activeDraftId or the newest unlocked draft, and the localStorage mirror wins if it is newer. ?project= opens the local draft when it is newer than the cloud revision it was based on.
File ▸ New resets in place; resetToNewProject no longer reloads. ProtectedPage keeps location.search in its continue param (line 52 uses pathname only).

steps.title: Opening overlay and error panel
steps.details: src/daw/session/OpeningOverlay.tsx sits at the DawApp root. It shows 'Opening ‘Name’…' over a dimmed editor (aria-busy). On failure it shows 'Couldn't open this project' with Retry and 'Back to my work', which reopens the kept draft.

steps.title: saveProject(), save chip and Undo/Redo buttons
steps.details: src/daw/commands/saveProject.ts is the single path for the menu, Cmd+S, the chip's Retry and Save As. It sets saving, error and cloudVersion, and shows an honest toast when content can't reach the cloud yet. SaveStatusChip sits next to the project-name input in TransportBar: Saved / Saving… / Unsaved / Saved on this device / Couldn't save – Retry (aria-live polite). Minimal Undo/Redo icon buttons sit beside it via useUndoState. Save As and Delete use Radix dialogs (a new PromptDialog and a destructive ConfirmModal) instead of window.prompt/confirm.

steps.title: Projects dialog
steps.details: src/daw/components/Projects/ProjectsDialog.tsx is a Radix Dialog in the current style with a search box and two lists. 'On this device' shows drafts, newest first, tagged 'Newer than cloud' where that applies. 'Saved' shows studioProjectsApi.list, fetched on open and cached. Open goes through openSession({kind:'draft'|'project'}); drafts can be deleted after a confirm. File ▸ Open… replaces the submenu with this dialog, and the auto-keep toast opens it.

milestones.title: Cloud document field: music-atlas-api contract and interim fallback (decision 5)
milestones.why: Cloud Save drops the chord lane, mode, metre, markers, mastering and notation while the toast says 'Project saved'.
milestones.effort: M (4–6 dev-days client) + M in music-atlas-api
risks: Older cached app tabs can still PUT legacy payloads that drop settings.projectDoc. The fallback can't be protected; the API field can.
Unknown body keys may be rejected or stripped by the legacy API, so the client sends 'document' only after capability detection.
The fallback blob rides on the first track; keep it compact (columnar ccEvents).

steps.title: Write the API contract
steps.details:
docs/studio-projects-document-api-contract.md follows the convention of docs/classroom-announcements-contract.md.
Schema: studio_project gains document JSONB NULL, document_schema INT NULL and revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.
GET /api/studio/projects/:id always returns the keys document (object|null), documentSchema (int|null) and revision. The presence of the document key is the client's capability signal.
POST accepts optional document and documentSchema.
PUT accepts optional document, documentSchema and baseRevision:
(a) baseRevision present and ≠ stored → 409 {error:'revision_conflict', revision, updatedAt}.
(b) documentSchema < stored document_schema → 409 {error:'document_schema_too_old', documentSchema}.
(c) No document key → the stored document is preserved unchanged, so older clients can never erase it.
(d) document present → top-level merge: body keys replace, absent keys are preserved, keys set to null are removed; document_schema = max.
(e) Tracks and clips are replaced as today.
(f) revision += 1 on every successful POST or PUT and is returned.
Validation: a plain object, ≤2 MB serialized (413 document_too_large); the server never interprets the content.
GET list and PATCH /:id/meta are unchanged, and meta does not bump revision. The migration is additive with no backfill; asset GC is unaffected.
Required server tests: preserve-on-omit, merge/null-delete, schema-too-old, revision conflict, size limit.

steps.title: Cloud document codec and types
steps.details: src/daw/persistence/projectDocument/cloudDocument.ts builds {schemaVersion:3, transport, harmony, notation, markers, mixer, tracks:{[trackId]:{trackRole, clips:{[clipId]:{durationTicks, ccEvents}}, pitchEdits}}} from the registry's cloud:true fields. The StudioProjectInput/Detail types gain document, documentSchema, revision and baseRevision.

steps.title: Interim fallback and a reader that scans every track
steps.details: While the server lacks the field, serializeSessionForCloud writes settings.projectDoc (plus projectDocSchema) on the first track; masterAutomation stays in its legacy place for one release. deserializeCloudProject reads project.document, else the first track whose settings.projectDoc exists, scanning every track as masterAutomationFromCloud does. It decodes with migrations onto initialProjectState(). Once a response carries 'document', the client stops writing projectDoc. Zero-track projects with harmony or notation content get an honest toast: 'Chord symbols are kept on this device until the project has a track'.

steps.title: Version and conflict handling
steps.details: saveProject sends baseRevision and documentSchema. A 409 document_schema_too_old sets the chip error 'Update Music Atlas to save' with Reload. A 409 revision_conflict opens a ConfirmModal: 'Changed on another device' with 'Save as a copy' / 'Overwrite'.

steps.title: Mock and contract tests
steps.details: mockStudioApi.mjs implements both legacy and document modes exactly as the contract specifies. src/lib/studio-projects/__tests__/cloudDocument.test.ts covers the reader scan, fallback write switching and conflict mapping.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check.
vitest: the reader finds the doc on track 3 after a reorder; deleting the first track and saving moves the blob; capable vs legacy write paths; 409 mapping.

The API owner reviews and acknowledges the contract doc. After the API deploys, one manual save/open against staging confirms the capability switch.

milestones.title: Command registry and scoped keymaps
milestones.why: A single unscoped keydown handler deletes clips the student can't see, hijacks text fields and browser zoom, and fights musical typing. Buttons and keys run different code.
risks: Muscle memory: Cmd+= and Cmd+− go back to browser zoom, and keys become scoped. Ship the '?' sheet and a one-time notice.
WCAG 2.1.4: single-key shortcuts must be possible to switch off (see open question).
Capture-phase view handlers must never swallow Space or Mod+S.

steps.title: Registry and dispatcher
steps.details:
src/daw/commands/registry.ts provides defineCommand({id, label, keys, scope, allowInEditable, repeat, when, run}). dispatcher.ts is the one window keydown listener. It returns early on:
- editable targets, unless the command sets allowInEditable (Mod+S only)
- [role=dialog], [role=menu] or [role=listbox]
- defaultPrevented or isComposing
- e.repeat, unless the command allows repeats
Scope stack: global > view (currentView) > focused region ([data-key-scope] on the timeline, track headers and dock) > musical typing > dialog. useKeyboardShortcuts is deleted.

steps.title: Command set
steps.details: Global: play/pause, record (requestRecord), stop, metronome, loop, save (saveProject), undo/redo (never inside editable targets), export MIDI (exportProjectMidi; 1.11 fills in the content), view switch. Arrange with the timeline focused: copy, paste, duplicate, delete, nudge, select-all, tools 1–4, and zoom-to-fit using the registered timeline viewport width. Cmd+=/−/0 are no longer intercepted; timeline zoom moves to Alt+=/Alt+− and Ctrl+wheel. The practice scope exposes transport only.

steps.title: View-owned keymaps
steps.details: Score (useScoreEditing), LeadSheetView, PianoRoll/PianoRollModal, PrismSuggestionModal and DrumMachineView register capture-phase handlers on their containers and preventDefault the keys they handle. Drum tool keys ignore modified keys.

steps.title: useMusicalTyping
steps.details: src/daw/hooks/useMusicalTyping.ts uses one map: A=C4 through ;=E5, with W/E/T/Y/U/O/P as black keys, Z/X for octave and C/V for velocity. It listens in the capture phase and feeds the shared live-notes path (hwNoteOn/hwNoteOff → monitored track + recording). A dock-header chip ('Computer keyboard: On/Off') toggles it, and while it is on, single-letter global commands are suspended. KeyboardView, SoundFontView, DawSynthLayout and oracle-synth/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts use it; the synth ignores keys when the target is a select, button or [role=slider].

steps.title: '?' shortcut sheet and one-time notice
steps.details: ShortcutSheet is a Radix dialog generated from the registry, grouped by scope and opened with '?'. A one-time toast says 'Shortcuts now follow the area you're working in'.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check.

vitest dispatcher matrix (jsdom): editable targets, dialogs, defaultPrevented and repeat. Delete in the score scope with a selected clip does not call removeMidiClip. Mod+= is not prevented. Mod+S works inside an input. No scope has duplicate bindings. Musical typing suppresses M and L.

Playwright: Delete in Score keeps the arrange clip. Alt+R in Lead Sheet doesn't record. Cmd+Z in the project-name input edits the text and leaves the store unchanged. Computer-keyboard playing doesn't toggle loop or metronome. R over an existing take shows the confirm from both the button and the key. '?' lists the commands.

milestones.title: Frame-rate state out of React; EngineHost and track reconciler
milestones.why: The 30 Hz playhead and per-frame meters flow through the main store and React state. That re-renders the editor 30–60 times a second, wakes the autosave, collab and undo listeners, and re-applies every track's engine state on every edit.
risks: Every reader of state.position (paste/split at playhead, marker navigation, snap, tutorial checks, collab transport sync) must switch to getPlayheadTick() or it will see stale values. Grep-driven checklist.
Meters go dead unless analysers are re-resolved after engine rebuilds.
The reconciler must keep today's instrument-swap semantics.
Prism key changes recolour every track (prism-ui-12). The reconciler ignores colour-only changes; the colour policy is an open question.

steps.title: playheadClock
steps.details: src/daw/engine/playheadClock.ts runs one rAF loop while playing or counting in. Display tick = transport.getTicksAtTime(rawCtx.currentTime − (outputLatency || baseLatency)). It exposes getPlayheadTick(), subscribePlayhead() and usePlayheadSelector(selector), a useSyncExternalStore hook with selector equality for current bar, chord index or system. useTransport writes position only on pause, stop and seek. Position-dependent actions read getPlayheadTick(): paste at the playhead, Timeline split at the playhead, TransportBar marker prev/next and snap, and Insight's 'now playing'.

steps.title: Ref-driven playhead layers and boundary-only renders
steps.details: Ref-driven transforms with no React state replace the playhead in Timeline (TimelinePlayhead), PianoRoll, StudioNotationView, DrumMachineView and the Score cursor (StaffView), and a ref-written text node replaces the TransportBar readout. LeadSheetView, LeadSheetScoreView and PracticeTrackView/ChordChart/ScaleKeyboard use usePlayheadSelector for the current measure or chord index, so they render only at boundaries. When paused, the parked chord stays lit.

steps.title: MeterBus
steps.details: src/daw/engine/meterBus.ts: registerMeter(el, source, kind) feeds one rAF loop at ≤30 Hz that runs only while playing, recording, monitoring or decaying. It resolves analysers lazily every frame via getTrackAudioState() and audioEngine.getMasterAnalysers(), applies dt-based peak hold and decay, and writes CSS variables or transforms. It replaces useMeterLevel and useCompressorMeters in TrackHeader, MasterTrackHeader, the StudioView strips (peak-hold markers now release), EffectsPanel/FxMeter, the GraphicEQ spectrum (ResizeObserver, reused buffers, no analyser retuning), the VocalView/GuitarBassView input meters (true clip detection) and the collab activity level.

steps.title: EngineClock and publish-on-change analysers
steps.details: src/daw/engine/engineClock.ts owns the optional loops: chord detection, guitar-to-MIDI, the RTC monitor (only while in a collab room), the tuner, synth visualizers (IntersectionObserver, and only while audio flows) and the mod indicator. Live chord, tuning and pitch info write to the store only when their values change.

steps.title: EngineHost
steps.details: src/daw/engine/EngineHost.tsx is a renderless sibling of the editor tree that hosts useTransport, usePlaybackEngine, useMidiInputRouting, useStudioMonitor, useCollabAudioLoader, useAudioChordDetection and useGuitarMidiDetection. DawAppInner then subscribes only to layout state (currentView, practiceSession, panel flags), and its regions are memoized.

steps.title: Track reconciler
steps.details: src/daw/engine/trackReconciler.ts replaces usePlaybackEngine's [isReady, tracks] effects with useStore.subscribe on tracks and a Map<trackId, Track> of last-applied objects. It skips identical objects and diffs the rest per field: volume, pan, the mute/solo set, effects, sends, instrument settings and automation. It re-asserts automation only for tracks whose lanes or static values changed, at one context time. A per-track init generation token disposes stale or orphaned instruments. Recording effects stop rewriting tracks on every edit.

steps.title: Narrow subscriptions
steps.details: The Insight panel uses a harmony-fingerprint selector. TrackHeader uses useTrack(id). PrismStudio, ChannelStrip and TrackControlsPanel select only the selected track by id.

steps.title: Lesson overlay stops repainting every frame
steps.details: Spotlight measures its target with ResizeObserver, scroll/resize listeners and a MutationObserver that waits for late anchors, instead of running querySelector every frame. The dim layer is static; the ring animates only opacity and respects prefers-reduced-motion. Confetti unmounts after its burst.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check.

studio:perf playback (chromebook profile): 0 main-store writes/s in steady playback. 0 commits/s for DawAppInner, TransportBar, Timeline, TrackHeader and ChannelStrip. Lead Sheet and Practice commits ≤ the number of chord changes. ≤1 long task per 20 s; p95 frame ≤20 ms.
studio:perf idle: no rAF loops (LoAF about 0).
Meters still move: a pixel diff of a meter element across two screenshots taken during playback.

vitest: playheadClock latency compensation with a fake transport. The reconciler applies only changed fields (TrackEngine setter spies). The stale-instrument token disposes late instruments. MeterBus pauses when idle.
Playwright: paste, split and marker navigation use the live playhead.
studio:lessons 8/8 (the spotlight still finds anchors).

milestones.title: Canvas and notation render cost
milestones.why: Waveforms rescan every sample on each redraw. One Score edit re-engraves every part twice. The piano-roll canvases are sized to the whole clip. The side panel animates its width beside the timeline canvas.
risks: Reference-keyed caches only miss, never go stale, as long as nothing mutates clips in place. Freeze state in dev tests to catch violations.
Worker-built peaks delay the first waveform. Keep the 'Loading…' tile.

steps.title: Peak pyramid
steps.details: src/daw/audio/peaks.ts keeps a WeakMap<AudioBuffer, PeakPyramid> with min/max for both channels at 256, 1k, 4k and 16k samples per bucket. It is built lazily on first draw, in src/daw/workers/peaksWorker.ts for buffers longer than 30 s (transferring a channel copy). computePeaks reads the nearest level for the visible window only, and replaced or pitch-shifted buffers get their own entry by identity.

steps.title: Timeline redraw discipline
steps.details: All triggers go through one rAF dirty flag (requestRedraw). draw() is memoised on a geometry selector (clip start, length, events ref, colour, offset, fades, mute) with custom equality instead of the whole tracks array. AudioBufferStore notifications are batched per frame. Drags redraw while playing. A ResizeObserver redraws when the container resizes, and CSS token values are cached.

steps.title: Piano-roll canvases sized to the viewport
steps.details: The grid, ruler and velocity canvases cover the visible window plus a margin and repaint on scroll or zoom, instead of covering the whole clip.

steps.title: Incremental Score engraving
steps.details: ScoreView caches each part's NotationScore by the track.midiClips reference plus key, mode, metre, slash notes and spellings. StaffView caches buildMeasure and measureMinWidth per (part, measure-content hash) and pre-measures rest-glyph widths once, so getComputedTextLength is no longer called inside the draw loop. Each system is drawn into its own group, and only dirty systems are redrawn. Width-only resizes don't re-engrave. The tieCandidates and marks lookups become Maps built once per layout.

steps.title: No animated widths next to canvases
steps.details: Opening or closing LibraryPanel changes the column width once and fades the content, so the Timeline no longer reallocates its canvas every frame.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check.
studio:perf audio-heavy fixture (6 × 3-min clips): draw() p95 ≤4 ms during scroll and zoom (performance.measure around draw). A fader drag causes 0 Timeline redraws.
vitest: the peak pyramid matches brute force at equal resolution, and replaced buffers are invalidated by identity.
Score: one note edit in a 6-part, 32-bar score paints in ≤50 ms on the laptop profile (Event Timing). measureMinWidth is called only for the edited measure (spy). A resize does not re-engrave.
Piano-roll canvas pixel size stays bounded by the viewport.

milestones.title: Edit transactions and undo history
milestones.why: Every pointer move commits to the whole project: an undo JSON check, a Yjs transaction, an engine re-apply and an autosave restart. Undo snapshots an inconsistent subset and records system writes.
risks: Undo granularity changes in a way students will notice; labels help in Phase 3.
Lesson checks (balance-fader, tweak-reverb, pad-mix, master-volume) must see the committed value on release.
Call sites not yet migrated rely on the idle-coalescing fallback.
Cap history to bound memory.

steps.title: useContinuousControl
steps.details: src/daw/hooks/useContinuousControl.ts uses pointer capture. preview(value) is rAF-coalesced and sets AudioParams with setTargetAtTime (10 ms) through new engine preview APIs (TrackEngine volume/pan/send, EffectChain params, mastering, organ drawbars, drum pads, pedal params), with a ref-driven readout. commit(value) runs once on pointerup or cancel: one store write, one undo entry, one Yjs update, one version bump. Unchanged values are skipped, and reverb Decay rebuilds its IR only on commit. Applied to TrackHeader, the StudioView mixer, RotaryKnob/EffectsPanel, OrganView, DrumMachineView and the GuitarBassView/VocalView knobs.

steps.title: Gesture commits in editors
steps.details: Note drags in PianoRoll/PianoRollModal, Score drags (useScoreEditing) and Lead Sheet drags keep their previews local and commit once.

steps.title: Patch-based history
steps.details:
src/daw/store/history.ts replaces snapshot diffing with:
- withTransaction(label, fn), and withoutHistory(fn) for seeds and system writes
- origin tags: user, system, remote, seed, undo
- a recorder on registry fields with undo:true that stores {label, before, after} for changed top-level keys by reference, with no JSON
- a 300 ms idle-coalescing fallback, a cap of 100 entries, and labels exposed for later UI
The undo scope now adds mastering, returns, master volume, key/mode/bpm/metre, markers, score slash/chord-visibility marks and the measure rest map. undoMiddleware keeps smartUndo/smartRedo as the entry points.

steps.title: Collab undo scope from the registry
steps.details: initCollabUndo builds its UndoManager scope from every registry field with undo && collab: tracks, chordRegions, markers, mastering, the lead sheet and score-mark maps.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check.

vitest: one gesture makes one labelled entry. Undo/redo works for mastering, returns, key, markers and score marks. Seeds are not undoable (Cmd+Z after a template keeps its tracks). Remote-origin writes are not recorded. The cap holds.
vitest: useContinuousControl commits once (testing-library pointer events).
vitest: the collab UndoManager scope covers the registry's Y types (Y.Doc unit).
Playwright: a 2 s fader drag makes 1 store write (store probe) and 1 undo entry. A note drag makes 1 write. studio:perf fader-drag shows 0 long tasks.
studio:lessons 8/8.

milestones.title: Time model and audio asset model
milestones.why: Clip-relative and song ticks are mixed, visual bars are confused with real bars, and 4/4 is assumed. Audio edits copy and evict buffers, so split, overwrite and undo play silence or the wrong audio, and memory grows with every project opened.
risks: Halves sharing one sourceId/assetId touch server asset GC (deleting one half must not delete the asset; confirm the API only deletes unreferenced assets), the upload dedupe and Yjs clip sync.
Pitch-edit caches keyed by clip id need re-keying.
Lesson checks read midiClips[0]; the binding order keeps it for single-clip tracks.

steps.title: timeModel module
steps.details: src/daw/time/timeModel.ts is built on timelineScale.ticksPerBar. It provides ticksPerBar(ts) with ts required, toSongTick/toClipTick, midiClipLength, splitMidiClip(clip, absTick) (trims straddling notes), snapTicks(tick, gridState), barSlots(state) mapping real bars to visual slots with multi-bar rests (shared with toSetListChart), and barToTick/tickToBar. Tested in 4/4, 3/4, 6/8 and 7/8, with rests.

steps.title: Replace hard-coded 1920 and 4/4 maths
steps.details:
Remove the 1920-tick and 4/4 assumptions everywhere:
- prismSuggestionSlice commit uses the real bar length.
- prismSlice's insert/delete measure becomes one metre-aware insertMeasures/deleteMeasures command that shifts chords, sections, repeats, breaks, rests, fermatas and melody events, with an explicit bar count.
- toSetListChart/leadSheetUtils durations, the LeadSheetView header and callbacks, LeadSheetToolbar, scoreClipboard paste before a part's first clip, PracticeTrackView and zoom-to-fit all use the time model.
- The 4/4 default arguments are removed.

steps.title: Clip editor binding
steps.details: PianoRoll takes {trackId, clipId} and derives its own origin and song offset. Bar lines, ruler and snapping use song bars, and chord colours are compared in song time. resolveEditorClip(trackId) picks the selected clip on that track, then the clip under the playhead, then the first clip; DrumMachineView, KeyboardView and ChannelStrip use it. GroovesBrowser 'Add to track' inserts one new clip at the playhead, so the 'load-groove' check (clip count) still holds.

steps.title: The chord lane follows only its source clip
steps.details: ChordRegion.sourceClipId is set by deriveChordRegions and by Prism. Moving a clip in the Timeline shifts only the regions that match it, clamped at 0. The snap toggle applies to clip, loop and marker drags, and toggling snap no longer moves the playhead.

steps.title: Asset store
steps.details: src/daw/audio/assets/assetStore.ts is keyed by sourceId. A sourceId is minted once per recording or import, aliased to assetId after upload, and equal to assetId on cloud load. Each entry holds the buffer, the original bytes, a status (loading/ready/failed/missing) and a retry count. AudioClip gains sourceId (codec + registry), and AudioBufferStore becomes a compatibility facade.

steps.title: Non-destructive split and overwrite; one moveClip
steps.details: tracksSlice.splitClipAt is used by the scissors tool, the context menu and the shortcut. For audio, both halves share sourceId and assetId with adjusted offsetSeconds and duration, keeping fades and gain; for MIDI it calls splitMidiClip. overwriteAudioRegion returns remainder references in a single store update. moveClip(trackId, clipId, toTrackId, startTick) checks locks and track types for Timeline drags and nudges.

steps.title: Reference counting and eviction
steps.details: referencedSources() is computed from the document plus the history stacks. Unreferenced buffers are evicted on project switch and when history entries drop off. Delete and undo never evict at edit time. Decoded buffers are reused across reopens by assetId, with an LRU cap.

steps.title: Load status, retry and honest tiles
steps.details: loadClipAudio records a status and retries with backoff (1 s, 4 s, 16 s, then manual), and useCollabAudioLoader stops retrying on every edit. The Timeline draws 'Loading…', 'Couldn't load — click to retry' and 'Audio missing (not uploaded)' instead of a fake random waveform. SamplerChopsView uses the same status.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check.

vitest: the timeModel table. splitClipAt on a trimmed clip (offsetSeconds maths, shared sourceId, gain and fades kept). Overwrite remainders. Refcounting: a buffer is kept while undo references it and evicted after the history entry drops or on project switch. moveClip rejects locked tracks and wrong types. insertMeasures in 6/8 shifts every measure-indexed field. barSlots with multi-bar rests matches toSetListChart.
studio:golden: a split project renders identically to the unsplit one, and undo after a split is audible.
Playwright: the dock piano roll on a clip at bar 5 shows its notes, and new notes land there. Insert measure works in a 3/4 lead sheet. A missing-asset mock shows the tile and Retry.
studio:lessons 8/8.

milestones.title: One playback scheduler; export and interchange parity
milestones.why: Audio is scheduled at 'now' instead of the time Tone supplies, so clips play early, the metronome drifts, notes stick or cut off, and edits and seeks aren't rescheduled. Export rebuilds the graph without its realtime parts, and the MIDI and MusicXML exporters re-derive the music with 4/4 assumed.
risks: Loop seams, count-in and record placement can regress (clicks, double triggers). Keep the legacy flag until the traces pass on Chrome and Firefox; check Safari manually.
Sound changes from removing the always-on crush (−2.4 dB) and fixing Oracle voices: accept them as golden diffs and send release notes to teachers.
Offline render progress via suspend() is Chrome-only; other browsers get an indeterminate bar.

steps.title: PlaybackScheduler
steps.details:
src/daw/engine/playbackScheduler.ts owns MidiScheduler, AudioClipScheduler, AutomationScheduler and MetronomeEngine. It reacts only to transport start/stop/pause/loop events and to seekTo, which calls reschedule(fromTick, when): fade running sources, allNotesOff(when), restart straddling clips and re-anchor automation.
- The transport starts at an explicit t0, and mid-clip sources start at t0 with their offset.
- Loop laps use the event time with 5–10 ms fades plus offsetSeconds and gain.
- Incremental Parts are keyed by clip id + object identity and replaced while playing.
- Count-in shares the accent logic and lands the downbeat exactly.
- Zero-length loops are rejected.
The legacy path stays behind localStorage 'ma:daw:legacyScheduler'.

steps.title: Time arguments in every adapter
steps.details: InstrumentAdapter.allNotesOff(time?) and panic(time?) are implemented in PianoSampler, SamplerInstrument and SoundFontAdapter (which also releases sustain and resets controllers), TonewheelOrganEngine (voice cleanup via onended) and DrumMachineEngine. Live MIDI note-offs go to the track that received the note-on. Groove preview is scheduled on the audio clock and cancelled on unmount.

steps.title: Oracle Synth on scheduled time
steps.details:
Changes in the Oracle engine:
- time is passed through allocateVoice, forceStop and Voice.noteOn; oscillators start with osc.start(time) and stop at time + fade.
- Voices are freed from onended, not setTimeout, and release starts from a computed envelope level.
- Allocation order: free voice → new voice → steal releasing → steal active.
- Arp steps are driven from transport time. MONO and LEG get a held-note stack, with glide from the last pitch.
- LFO phase is anchored to bars, unison gains start at their target, and a dispose during init cleans up.

steps.title: Context-agnostic graph builder and AudioWorklet dynamics
steps.details: buildTrackGraph(ctx, track) is shared by live playback and renderProject. EffectChain is split into per-effect modules created on first enable and fully bypassed when off, which removes the always-on tanh crush. Gate, ducker, de-esser detector and wah follower move into src/daw/audio/worklets/dynamics-processor.js, registered per context via WeakMap<BaseAudioContext, Promise>. The NAM and pitch-correction worklets are also registered per context and disposed. Pedal chains render offline from cached NAM models.

steps.title: Recording placement
steps.details: AudioRecorder captures through an AudioWorklet tap on the shared context and timestamps the first frame. The take is placed at transport.getTicksAtTime(captureStart − inputLatency) with output-latency compensation, and the recorder emits onTakeCommitted({trackId, clipId, startTick, buffer}). MidiRecorder uses event timestamps. Recording failures show a toast and release the mic.

steps.title: Export progress, cancel and worker encoding
steps.details: renderProject reports progress through offline-context suspend points and supports Cancel (stop resuming, restore the context). Encoding runs in src/daw/workers/encodeWorker.ts. ExportAudioDialog shows real progress with a Cancel button and lists the remaining differences (SoundFont tracks).

steps.title: Interchange reads the project document
steps.details: src/daw/midi/exportProjectMidi.ts writes MIDI with @tonejs/midi at 480 PPQ: clip offsets, length and trim, tempo, metre, key, velocities 0–1, drums on channel 10, a file named after the project, and a toast when there is nothing to export. The File menu and the Mod+E command both use it. MIDI import keeps tempo, metre, sustain CC and programs, and reports bad files and parts over the track limit. Lead-sheet and Score MusicXML go through buildScoreXml with the project metre, melody, roadmap and every mark; slur numbers stay in range; melody and chart printing are fixed.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check.
studio:golden at 44.1 and 48 kHz plus traces: clip starts, loop laps, metronome after pause and the count-in downbeat are within ±2 ms of the grid.
Seeking while playing leaves no source running past the seek time and no hanging notes.
A note changed during playback sounds on the next pass (trace).
An offline render of the two-note Oracle fixture has energy at each note's time and pitch.
Gate and ducker are audible in export.
Cancelling an export restores the live context.
The legacy-scheduler flag still plays.
vitest: exportProjectMidi output parsed by @tonejs/midi has ppq 480, correct offsets, ts and key, and drums on channel 10. MIDI import fixtures. MusicXML metre and marks.
Firefox smoke (installed playwright-core firefox build) of playback and export.

milestones.title: Instrument lifecycle, sample assets and code-splitting
milestones.why: The first Play on a demo is silent or partial while about 50 MB downloads. Load failures are silent and permanent. The editor ships as one 1.13 MB chunk that starts downloading only after auth and an unrelated songs gate.
risks: A suspended context changes assumptions: getIsInitialized() no longer means running, and SoundFont init resumes the context itself.
Chunk-load failures after a deploy are mitigated by the preloadError guard.
Lesson spotlights may target lazy panels; preload them and wait for anchors.
Sample, IR and SERUM-pack licences, and the audible change from a new kit, IRs or GM bank (golden renders + release notes).
vercel.json headers ship to prod on merge. Use versioned asset names so the immutable cache can't pin stale samples.

steps.title: InstrumentHost and status store
steps.details: src/daw/engine/instrumentHost.ts runs create → load(AbortSignal) → ready | error, with progress. Adapters reject on errors: PianoSampler gets onerror and a timeout, and SoundFont resets synthInitPromise and retries with backoff. useInstrumentStatusStore is a small store kept separate from the main one.

steps.title: Load before the gesture; Play waits with feedback
steps.details: AudioEngine.prepare() builds the graph and instruments on the suspended context at editor mount, and the first click or key only resumes it. Play waits up to 3 s for audible tracks and shows a white/10 'Loading sounds · 2/4' pill beside Play (aria-live) plus a per-track busy dot in TrackHeader. A failure shows 'Couldn't load sounds – Retry'. SoundFontView shows its programs and keyboard immediately, with progress over the keyboard. OracleSynthInline says 'Loading…' instead of 'not available'. The Prism suggestion preview preloads its instrument and routes through the selected track.

steps.title: SampleCache
steps.details: src/daw/audio/sampleCache.ts maps URL → Promise<AudioBuffer> with an LRU cap on decoded bytes. DrumMachineEngine, SamplerInstrument/PianoSampler, ChopsSampler, reverbIR and export share it. await Tone.loaded() is dropped, and engines survive leaving and re-entering the editor.

steps.title: Asset diet (owner approval required)
steps.details:
Each item needs owner approval:
- Re-master the Natural kit to ≤2 MB (trimmed tails, 16-bit, mono where the source is mono, compressed) with a tools/ script.
- Switch the demo bass to bass-electric.
- Ship the GM bank as SF3 or a curated subset, kept in Cache Storage.
- Self-host piano, Rhodes, cello and organ samples under public/daw-assets after a licence check.
- Add a reverb-IR licence check that fails studio:check, not the prod build, while any manifest licence says PLACEHOLDER.
- Organ: Leslie/vibrato graph off when unused, overdrive curve cached.

steps.title: Unblock and split the editor route
steps.details:
The editor route renders without ContentGate; the song boot awaits ensureSongContent inside openSession. src/daw/preload.ts provides preloadDaw, preloadDawView and preloadCollab, used by the ClassroomPages lazy(), studioPages() on /studio/editor and the StudioInlet tiles (pointerenter/focus, skipped when saveData is set).
Lazy boundaries, each via React.lazy or a mount-on-open wrapper:
- views: Score, Lead Sheet, Mix, Practice
- dock tabs: FX, Grooves, Prism, Piano roll
- instrument views: each branch of TrackControlsPanel.renderView
- modals, mounted on open: PianoRollModal, PrismSuggestionModal, SettingsModal, ExportAudioDialog, SetListUpdatePrompt, Tutorial internals
- the collab runtime, behind a CollabProvider facade
More splits: MIDI/MusicXML exporters become dynamic imports; PartialUploadError moves to src/lib/studio-assets/uploadErrors.ts; the hooks/data barrel stops pulling in the DAW store (split studio-projects/api.ts into list and save modules); CrystalIcons moves into the guitar chunk. Lessons preload the chunks their steps need.

steps.title: Skeleton, error boundaries, cache headers and fonts
steps.details: src/daw/components/DawSkeleton.tsx is CSS-only in the current proportions. It is the editor's Suspense fallback (ClassroomDashboard isStudioEditor) and sits behind the Opening overlay. DawErrorBoundary (react-error-boundary) flushes the draft and offers 'Reload editor', with per-view boundaries inside. A vite:preloadError listener flushes, then reloads once (sessionStorage guard). vercel.json adds headers: /assets immutable for 1 year; /daw-assets with a long max-age plus stale-while-revalidate and versioned names. The Google Fonts @imports are replaced by self-hosted WOFF2 with Regular preloaded.

steps.title: Bundle budget
steps.details: scripts/studio-perf/bundle.mjs asserts the boot DAW chunk is ≤150 KB gzip and reports per-chunk sizes. It runs as part of studio:check.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check.
studio:bundle: boot chunk ≤150 KB gzip (from about 286).

studio:perf load: the DAW chunk is requested before the auth bootstrap completes. The shell paints without songs content. The first Play on a demo waits behind the pill and is audible. Bytes before the first audible Play are reported (target <10 MB once assets are approved).
Playwright: a sample URL routed to 500 shows the error, and Retry recovers.
Playwright: a lazy chunk routed to 404 flushes the draft and reloads exactly once.
