milestones.title: Live input and Oracle Synth patch state live in the engine and the document
milestones.why: Pedal chains, NAM model, input routing and pad mix reach the engine only while a view is mounted. Synth patches sit in a global store plus a side cache, so reload, export, autosave, undo and collab all miss them.
risks: The synth UI depends on useSynthStore's shape, and lesson synthChecks read it. Keep it as the live editing surface.
Collab patch traffic stays bounded only because edits commit on release.
NAM CPU on Chromebooks: the silence gate is only a first step.
Preset and pack licences (SERUM-derived).

steps.title: applyTrackState in the engine
steps.details:
src/daw/engine/applyTrackState.ts runs at instrument init and from the reconciler when guitarChain, vocalChain, drumPads, drumKit or input fields change.
- GuitarPedalChain.apply(desired) matches processors by a stable block id (PedalBlockDescriptor.id), rewires only when the order changes, and updates parameters with ramps.
- The NAM model comes from a module cache that de-duplicates in-flight loads; a clean path plays while loading, and the status is exposed.
- Drum pad volume and pan are applied engine-side, and a kit change keeps custom pans.
- Views only edit store state; the guitar view keeps its selected block in uiSlice.

steps.title: LiveInputAdapter and LiveInputService
steps.details:
GuitarFxAdapter and VocalFxAdapter merge into a LiveInputAdapter base. src/daw/engine/liveInputService.ts owns getUserMedia per device, with one stream kept open while armed, and a status of connected / blocked / busy / disconnected / no-device, recovering on devicechange.
UI, minimal and inline: VocalView and GuitarBassView show a banner ('Microphone blocked — allow it in the address bar · Retry'); monitoring defaults off, with a one-time headphones ConfirmModal; the channel picker is built from the probed channel count.
Fixes: Settings stops requesting the mic on open; the output picker checks setSinkId on the native context; MIDI status is honest; the tuner shares the stream and runs YIN at ≤20 Hz; AudioMidiSourcePanel binding is fixed; a NAM silence gate skips compute below −90 dBFS.

steps.title: Live MIDI follows selection
steps.details: The deserializers no longer force-arm and monitor the first MIDI track. Monitoring and arming come from the per-user draft fields; when there are none, live MIDI plays the selected MIDI track.

steps.title: PATCH_SCHEMA and one applyPatch
steps.details:
src/daw/oracle-synth/patchSchema.ts lists each patch key with a default, a migrate step and applyToEngine. From it come:
- the Patch type with a version, capture/extract and the dirty flag
- migratePatch, shared by presets, snapshots, imports, demos and packs
- one diffed engine.applyPatch(patch, {projectBpm}), used by init, panel mount, preset load and export
applyPatch includes reverb, rebuilds LFOs once per apply at control rate, updates mod-route gains in place and re-applies the mod wheel. FX and mod route ids come from crypto.randomUUID().

steps.title: Patches in the document
steps.details:
oraclePatches[trackId] becomes a registry field in the main store: local, cloud via the track settings' oracleSynth, collab as a per-track Y.Map, and undo. useSynthStore stays the live editing surface, so lesson synthChecks (presetName==='WOBBLE') keep working; it is bound to oraclePatches[selectedTrackId] and commits per gesture. The synthTrackState cache is removed.
New Oracle tracks are seeded with INITIALIZE or a role-matched preset; templates use synthTrackStateFromPreset. resetSynthSession() runs on project switch. Loading a preset or INIT over a dirty patch shows an undo toast, and same-name user presets are auto-suffixed.

steps.title: Tempo, packs, wavetable modulation and CPU
steps.details: The reconciler pushes the project bpm to every Oracle engine, and the patch bpm is ignored. The pack manifest is registered at boot (loadAttempted is set only on success, with retry). Engines subscribe to the table registry and call ensureWavetables when tables register; tables are fetched lazily. WT-position and blend modulation run inside SynthEngine at control rate, offline too, and useWtPosModulation is deleted. PeriodicWaves are shared via a cache, noise buffers are created lazily, and the duplicate unison engine is removed.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check.
Playwright: reload a guitar project and the pedal chain and NAM model are applied without opening Controls (adapter state via trackEngineRegistry). Its golden render equals the pre-reload render.
Playwright: a fake mic reports 'connected'. A context without microphone permission shows the banner. Monitoring is off by default.
Playwright: a new Oracle track gets the INIT patch. A synth-only edit autosaves and undoes. After a reload, the patch is identical, including reverb and wavetables (golden).
studio:lessons: edm-design-the-drop (WOBBLE synthCheck) and 8/8.
vitest: an applyPatch spy sees every setter called. LFO rebuilds ≤4 per apply. bpm reaches every engine. migratePatch handles pre-v3 fixtures. Reusing pedals by block id keeps the NAM model.

milestones.title: Collab session as a real session
milestones.why: Session identity is modelled as socket status. A host's network blip ends the room, a refresh forks guests, deletions are inferred, remote edits rebuild every track and score marks don't sync.
risks: Mixed-version peers during rollout; the version gate refuses older clients.
During the grace period guests sit in a hostless room.
Durable Object alarm semantics.
The auth requirement may exclude tokenless viewers.
The server deploy (npm run partykit:deploy) must be coordinated with the client release.

steps.title: Session state machine
steps.details: collabSlice.session = {phase: idle | connecting | live | reconnecting | ended(reason), roomId, role, joinedAt, draftIdAtJoin, projectIdAtJoin}, persisted in sessionStorage and bound to the draftId. isCollabActive is derived from phase, and the File menu and permissions gate on 'in session' rather than the socket. Minimal UI: a 'Rejoin session?' dialog after refresh and a 'Host reconnecting…' banner. WaitingForSessionModal gets Cancel and a timeout. Errors go through sonner toasts. Leaving restores the pre-session draft in place, without a reload.

steps.title: Server grace period and version gate
steps.details: In party.ts, a host disconnect starts a 25 s alarm (room.storage.setAlarm/onAlarm) and broadcasts host:reconnecting; the alarm is cancelled when the host returns. The room stores docSchemaVersion and refuses older clients with a message. Debug logs are removed.

steps.title: Registry-driven sync
steps.details:
diffEngine, YjsDocManager's hydrate/observe and yjsToZustand are generated from the registry's collab columns:
- score and lead-sheet marks as per-key Y.Maps that peers apply
- chord-region field edits and MIDI CC
- effects and returns per key
- synth patches
Per-user fields (mute, solo, arm, monitor, inputs) are never synced. Deletions are computed as previous synced ids − new ids.

steps.title: Remote changes touch only what changed
steps.details: yjsToZustand applies per-track events and keeps unchanged Track and clip objects. The collab middleware opens a transaction only for registry keys. Chat history is appended in a single set.

steps.title: Presence and locks
steps.details: Presence moves to a small usePresenceStore outside the main store. A track is locked only while a peer is actively editing it (activity 'editing' within 10 s), and TrackHeader says so in place ('Ana is editing Bass'). Edits to a track that is merely selected are allowed. RTC setup no longer deadlocks when a joiner hasn't interacted yet. The per-room IndexeddbPersistence, which is never read back, is removed.

steps.title: Jam import safety
steps.details: setBpm and the time signature are applied before clips are created. The saved jam is cleared only after a successful import. Parts that didn't fit are reported.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check.

vitest: session transitions. Deletion set logic. A registry collab round trip (store → doc → store) for every collab field. yjsToZustand reuses unchanged objects by reference. The presence store is isolated from the main store.
party tests: unauthenticated close with 4401, the host grace alarm, refusal of an older version.

Playwright (npm run partykit:dev, two contexts): a guest refresh → Rejoin → back in the room. A host context.setOffline for 5 s → guests see 'Host reconnecting…' and stay. Leave leaves the pre-existing project untouched (mock API DELETE log) and restores the pre-session draft. A rejected room causes no reconnect loop (WebSocket count). A score mark made by A appears for B.

milestones.title: Lesson and practice persistence
milestones.why: A refresh ends lessons and the practice screen, while in-app navigation carries them into unrelated projects. Practice keys don't go through the student's track.
risks: Resuming the wrong lesson on a shared device: bind context to draftId and user id, and clear it on explicit exit.
Steps that compare against the armed snapshot must re-arm on resume.

steps.title: Session context travels with the draft
steps.details: DraftRecord.context = {tutorial: {id, stepIndex}, practiceSession, studentTrackId, view}. Autosave writes it and mirrors it in sessionStorage keyed by draftId. It is restored only in the matching draft. Every openSession that isn't a lesson or practice launch clears it, as do Quit lesson and Back to lesson.

steps.title: Resume behaviour and completion scoping
steps.details: Refreshing mid-lesson resumes at the same step with the work intact and a toast ('Resumed at step N'). Restarting from the Production tab auto-keeps the previous lesson draft. MSP completion is reported only for the tutorial launched from that MSP context.

steps.title: Practice inputs
steps.details: PracticeTrackView uses the persisted studentTrackId, not the selected track, for take feedback. ScaleKeyboard pointer presses and musical typing go through hwNoteOn/hwNoteOff to the student's track and are recorded.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check.
Playwright: at lesson step 3, a refresh returns to step 3 with tracks intact. Opening another project ends the lesson.
Playwright: refreshing the practice view restores the practice screen and key.
Playwright: clicking practice keys while recording puts notes in the take.
Playwright: two tabs running different lessons don't cross.
vitest: context binding to draftId; MSP completion gating.

milestones.title: Harmony correctness, generator safety and analysis off the main thread
milestones.why: Generators delete work. Chords are identified by display labels, and key and mode have several sources of truth. Analysis freezes the editor and analyses the wrong take.
risks: Lesson checks key off chordRegions identity (createRan) and chordSeq; Create must still produce a fresh, non-empty chordRegions array.
Worker transfer cost for long takes.
The key-colour policy is unresolved (see open question).

steps.title: Canonical chord identity and keyFrame
steps.details: ChordRegion and SuggestionChord carry {rootPc, quality (a CHORDS key), degreeKey}, and every label is derived through src/lib/chordNotation. A registry migration derives identity for saved regions. src/daw/prism-engine/engine/keyFrame.ts wraps getModeOffset, modeToIonianLabel and ionianToModeLabel and is shared by prismSlice and suggestionEngine. The harmony spectrum honours non-diatonic modes, E/G# gets its colour entry, and key names are spelled with the mode.

steps.title: An authoritative session key
steps.details: An effectiveKey selector makes the project key win. Detection fills it only when no key is set, labels it 'detected', and never assumes C major. Pitch Correction follows the project key unless its own key is chosen, and no longer re-keys the project. Insight chord cards follow the chord lane, and the selection analysis is invalidated when the selection changes.

steps.title: Generators never delete work
steps.details:
Prism Create writes a new clip at the playhead (or loop start) on the selected track. It reconciles chord regions only over the written range (sourceClipId), runs synchronously (no per-click Worker), makes one labelled undo step and shows a toast with Undo. generateChordMidi returns {events, spans}, so 2- and 3-chord loops are labelled correctly and the 7-chord limit is explained.
Builder Clear clears only the builder; 'Clear chord lane' becomes a separate, confirmed action in the chord-lane context menu. Suggestion commit trims partly overlapping regions instead of deleting them. Lead-sheet paste and clear are limited to the selection.
Set-list update: not offered for blank or smaller charts; the dialog shows a before/after summary with Keep as the primary action, and messages report real save results. The always-mounted set-list prompt stops rebuilding the chart on every edit.

steps.title: Validated chord entry
steps.details: ChordSymbol and Score chord entry parse input with readChordInput (Score/chordInput.ts) and show inline 'Not a chord name — try Cmaj7' instead of storing or silently dropping the text.

steps.title: Analysis worker and correct triggers
steps.details:
src/daw/workers/analysisWorker.ts runs OfflineChordAnalyzer (precomputed twiddles, tuning compensation shared with the live detector) and PitchAnalyzer YIN, with progress and cancel.
Triggers:
- Post-take refinement subscribes to onTakeCommitted and analyses exactly that clip, in project bars.
- Insight re-runs from a harmony-fingerprint subscription (notes, chord lane, key/mode, bpm, metre) with a cached result, not on mount or mixer edits.
Storage: per-clip analyses are stored by clipId, apart from the whole-song unisonDoc, which has a single writer.
UI: ChordAnalysisPrompt remembers 'Not now' per project (document flag) and runs in the worker. Audio clips get a 'Detect chords in this recording' context-menu item. Insight's empty, error and loading copy is honest, and 'Now playing' follows the playhead chord.

verification: Common gate: npm run lint; npx vitest run; npm run studio:check.
vitest: A-minor suggestions (degree labels, voiced from the parent root). Chord identity round trip and label derivation. effectiveKey precedence.
vitest: Create keeps existing clips and the chord regions outside its range (store before/after) and makes a single undo entry.
vitest: builder Clear leaves chordRegions. Partial overlaps are trimmed. Paste is limited to the selection. The set-list prompt is suppressed for a blank chart. readChordInput rejects junk.
Playwright: a fixture take recorded through the fake media stream → refinement analyses the new clip id, with 0 long tasks during analysis.
Playwright: fader drags don't trigger Insight analysis (counter).

milestones.title: Honesty pass, dead-code removal and Phase 1 exit report
milestones.why: Controls that do nothing teach students the wrong things. Dead modules ship in the editor chunk and their copies drift.
risks: Hidden controls must not carry lesson anchors; fx-add-*, synth-preset-selector and fx-slot-* stay.
Some deletions wait on owner answers (pitch editor, orchestrator, live UNISON).

steps.title: Hide or fix controls that do nothing
steps.details:
- Synth FX: TARGET is hidden.
- Synth filter: ON/OFF and PAN are hidden until implemented, and GAIN shows only for peaking/shelf types.
- De-esser: FREQUENCY is hidden until its band filter is wired.
- Grooves: the six dead controls and the empty genres are hidden.
- Instrument views: fake controls are removed.
- Presets: label-only ones are hidden or mapped (owner choice).
- FX list: no longer draggable without a drop target, and the 5-effect cap is shown.

steps.title: Delete dead modules
steps.details:
Delete:
- shell remnants: StatusBar, ui/minimal-dock, ui/demo
- Mixer/MixerPanel, Mixer/ChannelStrip, TrackList, NewTrackModal, NamModelBrowser, PresenceCursors
- the oracle-synth main.tsx/App.tsx shell
- InfoPanel, RootNoteSelector, PrismDrawer
- VocalProcessingChain, DelayPedal, ReverbPedal
- the dead data in sampleLibrary/projectMeta
The PitchEditor stack is unmounted now and deleted only on the owner's yes; the orchestrator, band generators and useLiveUnisonAnalysis follow the owner's answer.

steps.title: Collapse duplicates and small per-frame waste
steps.details: Extract shared rack wiring and shared live-chord logic in InsightContent. Share helpers for groove loading, pad mapping and collab note relay. NodeTapCapture returns a dedicated tap node. The marquee dedupes with a Set. detectChordWithInversion caches its definitions. Track headers measure rows only during a drag, and the opaque header column drops its backdrop blur. The sampler waveform reuses its canvas.

steps.title: knip gate and exit report
steps.details: knip.json is scoped to src/daw (entry DawApp.tsx), and npm run knip is clean for it. docs/studio-perf/phase-1-exit.md compares baseline and final values for every exit metric, and phase-map.json records the final status of every finding.

npm run knip is clean for the DAW scope.

A full npm run studio:check meets every Phase 1 exit criterion on both profiles.

steps.title: Anchor registry with rename/parent alias map
steps.details:
**anchors/anchorRegistry.ts**
- A Map<AnchorId, Set<{el, priority}>> with subscribe().
- anchorRef(id, {priority}) returns a cached callback ref that works inside loops. It registers the element and also sets data-tutorial-id, which Playwright and the DOM fallback rely on.
- useTutorialAnchor(id) wraps it.

**anchorIds.ts**
- An AnchorId union of the 40 current ids, including the template families:
  - view-switch-${ViewType}
  - chanstrip-tab-${ChannelStripTabId}
  - add-track-${InstrumentType}
  - fx-add-*, fx-slot-*
  - mixer-sends-*, return-strip-*, return-fx-*
  - sampler-mode-*
- Plus new ids added later: song-chip, track-menu-button, project-export-submenu, project-open.

**anchorAliases.ts**
- RENAMED: old→new. It stays empty because ids never change, but is kept as a safety valve.
- PARENT: maps an anchor to the disclosure trigger that reveals it. It grows as controls move behind menus, popovers or collapsed sections.

**resolveTarget(target)**
- For each id: apply RENAMED, take the first registered element with a non-zero box, otherwise walk PARENT.
- Among duplicates, higher priority wins (for example the selected row's ⋯ button).

**Also in this step**
- A DEV hook: window.__MA_TUTORIAL__ = {resolve, registered}.
- Convert the ~38 static data-tutorial-id sites to anchorRef. The change is mechanical and every id stays the same.

steps.title: Spotlight and CoachCard driven by the registry
steps.details:
Spotlight and CoachCard subscribe to the registry and measure with ResizeObserver plus scroll and resize listeners. This replaces the per-frame querySelector and getBoundingClientRect calls.

Spotlight:
- A static dim instead of the animated 9999px box-shadow.
- A ring that animates opacity only, switched off under prefers-reduced-motion.

Confetti unmounts after its burst.

CoachCard:
- Dragging is constrained to the viewport, and the card resets on every step.
- role=dialog, aria-modal=false, aria-labelledby pointing at the title.
- The instruction and status sit in an aria-live=polite region.

TutorialLayer recovery: if no target resolves within 1.5 s and step.requires.view differs from currentView, spotlight view-switch-<view> with a 'Go back to Create' hint.

The look is unchanged otherwise. Skip any of these findings Phase 1 already closed.

steps.title: Lesson walkthrough runner
steps.details:
lessons.mjs, with drivers in lessonDrivers.mjs. For each of the 8 lessons it boots /studio/editor?tutorial=<id> through the Phase 1 boot. Then, for each step:
1. Wait for __MA_TUTORIAL__.resolve(step.target) to become visible, for up to 5 s.
2. Assert that the CoachCard rect does not intersect the target.
3. Run the step's driver:
   - Real clicks for every navigation step: add-track, dock tabs, view tabs, menus, the Song popover and dialogs.
   - Store or synth-store setters only for content steps: choosing G, adding chords, swing, drum hits, automation points, faders and sends, and the WOBBLE preset.
4. Wait for tutorialStepIndex to advance, or for useTutorialProgressStore to mark the lesson complete.

It runs at 1366×768 and 1440×900 and reports, per step, the resolve time and whether the step went through the UI or the store.

The baseline run on today's shell must pass 8/8 before 2.1 starts, and every later milestone re-runs it.

No generator (Prism Create, Suggest, Grooves) changes the project document before Keep. Each Keep is one labelled undo step, and Cmd+Z restores the document exactly (deep-equal).
Every chord label renders from {rootPc, quality, degreeKey} through lib/chordNotation. Key and mode changes never modify track.color. Colour clips by Track/Harmony is saved with the project.
Every FX rack and Oracle FX list matches engine processing order (wiring tests). Every visible preset and control changes the sound, or it is hidden.

The visual rules hold across src/daw. The Phase 2 ESLint guard (no hex literals, no sub-floor text, no literal z-index) passes with no file-level disables. DOM scans find no text under 12 px (except [data-micro] 11 px uppercase), no target under 24×24 and no teal in chrome.

No regression against the Phase 1 performance budgets (drag and playback frame times, long tasks, bundle size). Golden offline renders match except for documented, teacher-noted changes.

milestones.title: Shared editor core (src/daw/editor)
milestones.why: Timeline, piano roll, drum grid, Score and Lead Sheet each implement their own selection, snapping, pointers, zoom, follow and menus. The result: selection by array index, drags stuck outside the canvas, a grid fixed at 1/4, no follow-playhead. Fixing these once makes every editor behave the same.

steps.title: Stable note ids and selection by id
steps.details:
Add id to MidiNoteEvent: optional on the engine type, always present in the store.

src/daw/editor/noteIds.ts:
- newNoteId(): 8-char base36 from crypto.getRandomValues
- ensureNoteIds(events): keeps existing ids, mints missing ones, de-dupes

Run it inside the tracksSlice actions that accept events (addMidiClip, updateMidiClipEvents, loaders/setTracks), so recording, Prism, grooves, MIDI import, templates, practice seeds and jam import all get ids without per-site code.

encodeMidiEvents/decodeMidiEvents carry an optional ids column; decode mints ids when the column is missing.

Ids are runtime identity. The notation codec writes persisted marks as position keys (clipId:startTick:midi) and resolves them back to ids on load, so a cloud save that drops unknown event fields cannot orphan marks. Ids travel with events in Yjs so peers converge. Ids are minted before the documentVersion baseline, so loading never marks a project dirty.

src/daw/editor/selectionStore.ts is a session-only zustand store {scope, clipId, ids, anchorId}. reconcile(events) runs on every events change; switching clips clears the selection. insightSelection's ClipNoteSelection moves from noteIndices to noteIds.

steps.title: Metre-aware grid, snap and Grid menu
steps.details:
src/daw/editor/grid.ts:
- GridValue = bar | beat | 1/2 | 1/4 | 1/8 | 1/16 | 1/32 | 1/2T | 1/4T | 1/8T | 1/16T | adaptive
- gridTicks(value, ts, ppb) uses ticksPerBar/ticksPerBeatUnit and Phase 1 timeModel.snapTicks; snapping is bar-anchored, so triplets align in 3/4, 6/8, 5/4 and 7/8
- adaptive picks the finest visibleSubdivisions level that is at least 12 px wide
- holding Alt during a drag bypasses snap; this is shown in the drag tooltip and the '?' sheet

Fold the four snap copies into grid.ts: Timeline.snapTick, quantize.snapToGrid/snapToGridTicks, the local snaps in PianoRoll and DrumMachineView, and AutomationLaneEditor.

GridMenu.tsx (Radix DropdownMenu) holds:
- Snap on/off; it replaces TransportBar's Magnet button and fixes its inverted seek by capturing wasEnabled and never seeking while playing
- grid radio items
- a triplet group

Used by the Create canvas toolbar, the Notes editor and the drum grid.

steps.title: Pointer gesture controller
steps.details:

- pointerdown calls setPointerCapture

- moves are coalesced to one per rAF

- pointercancel, lostpointercapture and Escape cancel and restore the original
- the right button never draws
- exposes modifiers: Shift additive, Cmd/Ctrl toggle, Alt snap bypass, Alt+drag copy

Drafts live in refs and draw on an overlay layer, never in the store.

Used by 3.3 (clips, loop, markers, automation), 3.4 (notes, velocity, drum steps), 3.9 and 3.10 (notes, chords) and 3.11 (LFO nodes, wheels).

steps.title: Follow playhead and zoom controls
steps.details:
Follow is a uiSlice preference, persisted per user and on by default; Phase 2's top-bar toggle drives it.

src/daw/editor/useFollowPlayhead.ts reads the Phase 1 playheadClock (no React state):
- while playing, pages when the playhead passes 85% of the viewport and lands it at 10%
- pauses for 3 s after wheel, scrollbar or drag input; resumes on play or seek
- jumps instead of smooth-scrolling under prefers-reduced-motion
- pure nextScrollForPlayhead() for tests

src/daw/editor/ZoomControls.tsx: −, Fit, + and a % Readout.
- Fit measures the editor's own viewport; this replaces the 800 px guess in useKeyboardShortcuts zoomToFit
- Ctrl/Cmd+wheel zooms proportionally (zoom *= exp(−deltaY·k)) about the cursor via uiSlice.zoomAtPoint
- browser Cmd+=/− stay the browser's

steps.title: Shared context menus and scoped editor keymaps
steps.details:
src/daw/editor/EditorContextMenu.tsx is built on src/components/ui/context-menu.tsx (Radix). Its items are Phase 1 registry commands with label, shortcut, and enabled-or-reason. It opens on right-click, Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key on a focused clip, note, chord or marker. Menu contents:

steps.details:
selectEffectiveKey(s) returns {rootPc, mode, source}, in priority order:

steps.title: Take model: ghost preview, audition, labelled commit
steps.details:
src/daw/store/takeSlice.ts is session state, never part of the document. Its pendingTake is {source prism|suggest|groove, trackId, range {startTick, lengthTicks}, clip (events with ids), chordRegions (with identity), label, overlap replace-range|new-clip}.

Target picker in the footer: loop range, selected bars, playhead bar, after the last clip, or a new track. If the range already has notes it warns: 'Replaces notes in bars 9–12 (undoable)'.

The take shows as a ghost:
- on the Timeline overlay: translucent, dashed, with a 'Preview' tag
- in the chord lane
- as ghost notes in Notes

Audition plays the song from the range start with the take on its track, under a temporary preview loop that is restored afterwards (Phase 1 scheduler preview clip).

commitTake:
- one labelled transaction, e.g. 'Prism: 4 bars to Rhodes at bar 9'
- chord regions are reconciled only inside the range; straddling regions are trimmed or split, metre-aware
- a toast offers Undo

Discard leaves the document untouched. The take and Suggest state reset with the Phase 1 session reset.

Create calls generateChordMidi synchronously and returns {events, spans}; delete midiWorker.ts.

Anchors: prism-key; prism-chord-selection (palette); prism-harmony (Progression zone); prism-style; prism-rhythm (includes More); prism-create (footer primary).

milestones.why: The Score can't write notes, re-engraves the whole page on every edit, loses its working state on view switches, moves marks onto the wrong notes after edits, and never follows the playhead.

steps.details:

steps.details:

- cache each part's NotationScore by midiClips reference

steps.title: Note-input mode and audition
steps.details:

- A–G place a pitch in the nearest octave; Shift/Ctrl+↑/↓ shifts the octave
- digits pick durations, '.' adds a dot, 0 enters a rest
- ←/→ move the caret; Backspace deletes
- Web MIDI step entry; held keys form chords
- click-to-place with a ghost note
- entering into bars with no clip creates or extends one

Selected, moved and entered notes audition through the track's instrument. Alt-click on a bar moves the playhead. 'Play from selection' plays from the selection.

Note drags start after 6 px or a 150 ms hold, with vertical hysteresis, pointer capture and pointercancel handling.

steps.title: Keyboard-only journeys
steps.details:

- select a track (↑/↓), Enter into Notes, add/move/delete a note

collab-22 (remainder): moderation beyond Remove (turning chat off, retention, name display for minors). This is a policy decision.

Dropped (owner decision 2, one interface): the Simple/Advanced mode and density-toggle proposals (ia-flows proposal section 8, design-system proposal section 7, timeline-21's compact/comfortable idea). Follow is on by default for everyone instead of 'on in Simple mode' (ia-flows-27).
Replaced (owner decision 8): ia-flows-14's fix of unlocking Prism during lessons. Prism lessons get a Premium badge and an upgrade prompt instead, and Prism stays locked.

Out of scope for the editor overhaul: the Learn and global-layout items of the 2026-09-20 audit (#1, #2, #4, #5, #6, #10, #15, #17, #18, #20); teacher comments; a version-history UI; a Sections ruler; a natural-language command bar.
openQuestions: Student audio-file import (timeline-16, fx-mixer-24): should students be able to import WAV/MP3/M4A, given GCS storage cost and the 6-audio-track cap?
Prism Create default target when the playhead bar already holds notes: replace that range (undoable, with a warning), or write after the last clip?
Does any lesson or curriculum teach loudness targets (e.g. −14 LUFS)? If not, 'Peak' stays and real LUFS remains deferred.
Print paper default: Letter, A4, or a per-school setting?
Score defaults: write bass and guitar parts 8vb, and use a grand staff for keys, by default?
Session tab for minors: show full names or first name plus initial? Should hosts be able to turn chat off? How long should chat be kept in PartyKit snapshots?
Composer field in shared sessions: whose name wins, and should it ever auto-fill?
Grooves: keep both the dock Grooves tab and the Browser's Grooves section, or move groove browsing into the Browser only?
Should grooves favourites be per device (localStorage, the current plan) or synced to the account through music-atlas-api?

orderingIssues: Precondition for 1.0: the decision-11 code isn't committed yet. The ?tutorial boot branch in src/daw/DawApp.tsx, the untracked src/components/ClassroomLayout/studio/StudioProduction.tsx, and changes to ClassroomPages, routes and LibraryPanel sit uncommitted on branch 'aaron', mixed with an unrelated Google sign-in feature (src/auth/google, AuthContext). The chains 1.9→1.3→1.1 and 1.12→1.7/1.11 never reach 1.4. Add 1.4 to dependsOn of 1.9 and 1.12, and 1.10, 1.13 and 1.16 inherit it.

1.4's restore rule ('?project= opens the local draft when it is newer than the cloud revision it was based on') and DraftRecord.cloudRevision need the revision field, which arrives only with 1.5 plus the music-atlas-api deploy. Specify an updatedAt-based rule for 1.4 until revision exists.

The collab version gate (docSchemaVersion refusal) lands in 1.14, after earlier Y.Doc shape changes: 1.10 adds AudioClip.sourceId to clip sync and 1.13 adds per-track oraclePatches Y.Maps. More changes follow later: 3.1 note ids in Yjs events, 3.2 chord identity fields, 3.10 measureRowSizes→scoreSystemBreaks. Move the handshake into 1.1 next to the 4401 change, so it ships in one coordinated partykit deploy. Make every later shape change bump it.

1.1 closes tokenless sockets (collab-16) without the client change the audit's regression note requires. y-partykit reconnects reuse the original URL token, so a student whose Auth0 token has expired gets 4401 on any network blip mid-class. CollabProvider must pass params as an async function that returns a fresh token; y-partykit 0.0.33's ParamsProvider supports () => Promise<Params>. That client change must ship before the server change is deployed.

audio-core-17 isn't fixed until 1.12, about five months in. The PLACEHOLDER-DO-NOT-SHIP, Logic-derived IRs are served from public/daw-assets/reverb-irs in prod today. From 1.12 on, its licence check also fails studio:check for every later milestone until a licensed pack exists. reverbIR.ts already falls back to the synthetic IR when the manifest is empty, so in 1.2: filter out PLACEHOLDER entries (or remove the files) and record the golden diff.

The data-loss criticals timeline-01 and audio-core-06 (and the high audio-core-07) wait for 1.10. The audit's minimal fix doesn't need the asset store: halves and remainders share the buffer and assetId, use an adjusted offsetSeconds, keep gain and fades, and nothing is evicted at edit time. Ship it in 1.1 and let 1.10 generalise it.

1.17 deletes dead modules only after 1.7–1.13 have refactored and code-split the same tree (MeterBus, useContinuousControl, lazy boundaries). Move the deletions that don't need owner sign-off to 1.2; P3 3.0 gives the same reason. One catch: 1.17 deletes NewTrackModal, but P2 2.6 reuses its one-line descriptions, so move them into AddTrackMenu first.

1.12 (code-split, DawSkeleton, vite:preloadError guard, ContentGate removal) depends on 1.11's XL scheduler rewrite but doesn't need it, and all of Phase 2 depends on lazy views and the skeleton. Split 1.12: the bundle/boot half follows 1.4 and 1.7; the InstrumentHost and asset half follows 1.11.

P2 2.4 puts today's 48px TransportBar (className h-12) into a 44px top row. It also asserts the 1366×655 focus-mode budgets (body = height − 44) before focus mode exists, which only arrives in 2.5. As shipped, 2.4 clips the bar and its region-box checks can't pass. Keep the row 'auto' until 2.5 and move the budget assertions to 2.5.

1.6 builds view keymaps as capture-phase handlers on each view's container. P2 2.11 generates its shortcut sheet from the registry, grouped by Score, Lead sheet and Notes, and P3 3.1/3.9 register keymaps with the dispatcher. Register view keymaps as registry scopes in 1.6, or the sheet and tooltips can't list them. Similarly, 1.7's MeterBus writes CSS variables to registered elements, but P2 2.2's canvas Meter needs a subscribe(source, cb) API. Define that API in 1.7.

critique.overallAssessment:
Coverage is complete: every critical and high finding has an owner, so no assignments are needed, and each phase is grounded in real files. But the three plans were written independently and don't yet form one program.

1. **Duplicated work.** More than 20 artifacts are built two or three times, sometimes with incompatible APIs or paths: the harness and lesson runner, anchor registry, Spotlight/CoachCard, Premium gating, Projects and Prompt dialogs, shortcut sheet, musical-typing chip, Grid/Zoom/Follow, harmony core, generator safety, effect modules, and the Session, Browser, Settings, Export and MIDI-import panels. Phase 3 also edits about 12 files that Phase 2 deletes.
2. **Data formats churn across phases.** clipColorMode classification, score-mark keys, chord identity and pitch edits each change more than once, forcing schema and documentSchema bumps that no plan versions.
3. **Operational gaps carry the most risk.**
   - The collab version gate lands after the first Y.Doc shape changes.
   - 1.1's 4401 change ships without token refresh, and it makes local two-context collab tests impossible. Host and kick logic is already untestable locally, because the bypass token isn't a JWT.
   - The autosave mirror key isn't namespaced by user on shared Chromebooks, and old tabs overwrite it.
   - Un-uploaded audio isn't covered by the crash-safe drafts.
   - The PLACEHOLDER reverb IRs stay in prod until 1.12 and then block studio:check.
4. **Verification gaps.** Nothing tests mixed-version collab, cloud round trips through legacy clients, real-Chromebook audio, lessons at 1366×655, SoundFont tracks (silent in offline renders), or Learn regressions from StaffView changes.
5. **Concrete decision violations.** P2 2.3 adds a confirm to New Project. The Practice screen has no save chip or avatar menu. The 96px save chip can't hold decision 6's labels at 12px. The 1.1 interim backup is one silent slot. Presence, rainbow and confetti colours have no owner sign-off.

Phase 1 is also under-sized; expect 40–50 weeks, and split 1.11, 1.12 and 1.13.

Recommended order of fixes:
- Run one owner-map pass across phases, so Phase 2 and 3 restyle Phase 1 UI instead of rebuilding it.
- Rebase Phase 3 on Phase 2's src/daw/shell layout.
- Pull the version handshake, token refresh, the IR filter and the minimal non-destructive split/overwrite into 1.1–1.2.
- Standardise one harness (scripts/studio-perf) and one viewport matrix (1366×655, 1440×787, 1280×720).
- Add mixed-version and real-device gates.
